title: Gift Budget Overrun by Recipient
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=giftbudget:item
| search overrun_amount>0
| stats sum(overrun_amount) as overrun_amount count as items by recipient_name
| sort 0 - overrun_amount
value: Recipient-level overruns show where generosity is drifting past the plan and needs a reset.
implementation: Send gift-budget overruns events to `index=personal` and keep `recipient_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of gift-budget overruns by recipients.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which recipientss stand out most for gift-budget overruns.
